Emma (People Ops): Heads up — we rolled a compact handbook update this morning that consolidates PTO, travel stipend, and compliance training sections. Link: https://handbook.redwood.ai/compact-2026 :sparkles:
Ravi K: Nice. Is this replacing the existing PTO policy or just clarifying wording?
Emma (People Ops): Clarifies + a few small policy changes (see TL;DR in doc). Key action: mandatory 20‑minute microlearning for PTO accrual changes + a quick acknowledgment by managers for direct reports by next Thu.
Miguel L: 20 minutes total? live session or async?
Emma (People Ops): Async module in our LMS (1 video + 3 quiz questions). Should take ~20 min. We'll mark completion in the LMS and push a manager confirmation task.
Priya S: What about international teams where local law differs? Do we have opt-outs?
Emma (People Ops): Good catch — there are jurisdictional callouts in the doc (see Appendix B). If local law overrides, do not complete the PTO change quiz; instead complete the "Local Policy Acknowledgment" card.
Sam T: Can managers get a CSV export of their team's completions? I need to attach to performance calibration packets.
Emma (People Ops): Yes — export will be available. Quick CLI snippet for downloads: ```hr-export completions --team <manager_email> --since 2026-04-01 --format csv > emma-team-completions.csv```
Ravi K: Who exactly is in scope for the mandatory module? full-time + part-time? contractors?
Emma (People Ops): Scope: all FT/PT employees on payroll. Contractors are excluded unless their engagement is >6 months and sponsored by a product team — we flagged those IDs in the LMS.
onboarding-bot: Reminder set: Mandatory microlearning due by 2026-04-14 for channel people-ops.
Miguel L: Any penalty for missing?
Emma (People Ops): We'll notify managers; repeat misses will trigger a 1:1 from HR to understand blockers. No automated access revocations.
Priya S: Can we add captions to the video? Need to be accessible.
Emma (People Ops): Yes, captions exist and Spanish/FR transcripts will be uploaded by EOD.
Sam T: I'll grab the CSV once available. Also re: travel stipend — is that a blanket raise or discretionary?
Emma (People Ops): Stipend adjustment is a change to the reimbursement threshold (+$100 annual). Details and examples in the handbook page.
Ravi K: Thanks — I'll ping my managers to look for the LMS reminder. :thumbsup:
Emma (People Ops): Appreciate it. If anyone needs bespoke manager rollout slides, tell me and I can paste a 3‑slide deck. :slightly_smiling_face:
Miguel L: Can you drop the slide deck here when you have it?
Emma (People Ops): Dropping deck now: https://redwood-assets.s3/peopleops/compact-update-deck.pdf :paperclip: 
Priya S: Thanks — will distribute to EMEA managers with localization notes.
Sam T: All set from my side.
Emma (People Ops): Closing loop — final reminder on Thursday morning and LMS will show completion flags. Thanks team. :sparkles:
